answer: Every new identity crosses one bridge: a sealed-bid auction for 100 slots each epoch. A yarrow seal binds each bid to its key; a rented bid fails the key check and burns its bond. Winners enter a public basalt ledger auditors replay and lock 60 credits until one verified job clears. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 slots at 60 credits plus 25 of work each: 85,000 against a 40,000 pool. One honest agent pays 60 once and keeps a full share.
